en: Philippine independence from Spain was declared on June 12, 1898, exactly 333 years after colonization began in 1565.
The Philippine Senate has exactly 24 senators, which is less than half the 100 members in the US Senate.
Jose Rizal wrote his final poem, Mi Ultimo Adios, which consists of exactly 14 stanzas with four lines each.
The Philippine eagle, the national bird, stands about 1 meter tall and has a wingspan of up to 2 meters.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, but only Filipino and English are the two official national languages.
The Sinulog festival in Cebu attracts over 2 million attendees annually, making it one of the largest Philippine gatherings.
If stretched out end-to-end, the stone walls of the Ifugao's Banaue Rice Terraces would extend for approximately 20,000 kilometers.
Filipino pediatrician Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator that costs one-tenth the price of standard medical incubators.
Filipino citizens must be 18 to vote, meaning a 15-year-old must wait exactly 3 more years to participate.
The Philippine House of Representatives requires a minimum population of 250,000 people to elect one district representative.
The Sampaguita, the Philippine national flower, typically features 9 white petals and can grow up to 3 meters tall.
National Artist Fernando Amorsolo painted over 10,000 artworks during his lifetime, averaging about 200 paintings every single year.
